HERO.SUBTITLE: Hi, I'm Luca. I design and develop innovative, fast, and pixel-perfect user interfaces.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.P1: I am a Front-End Developer focused on creating elegant, intuitive, and accessible user interfaces.
ABOUT.P2: While my primary focus is the client-side, my Full-Stack background allows me to understand and manage the entire application architecture. I love turning complex problems into simple, beautiful, and intuitive designs.

PROJECT_1.TITLE: Kennel Admin Portal
PROJECT_1.DESCRIPTION: A complete management portal for a dog boarding kennel. Features include dog and owner registries, stay management, interactive kennel scheduling, and a 'kiosk' system for digital document signatures.

PROJECT_2.TITLE: Forlini Garden Center
PROJECT_2.DESCRIPTION: E-commerce platform and showcase website for a garden center. Features an interactive product catalog, advanced filtering, cart management, and a dedicated administration panel.

PROJECT_3.TITLE: Il Botteghino
PROJECT_3.DESCRIPTION: A comprehensive web application for restaurant management. Features include an interactive digital menu, photo gallery, and table reservation system, along with an admin panel for real-time menu management.

PROJECT_4.TITLE: Luca Garizio Portfolio
PROJECT_4.DESCRIPTION: My personal portfolio. Built with Angular and Tailwind CSS, featuring a dynamic multi-language system, modern animations, and EmailJS integration for contact management.
